title: Local MixVR: Breaking the Communication-Sample Dependence in Distributed Learning
abstract: arXiv:2606.01128v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Communication overhead is a crucial bottleneck in scalable distributed learning. While existing methods aim to efficiently utilize data points, such as Local SGD, Minibatch SGD, and their accelerated variants, they still exhibit communication-round complexity that scales with the total number of samples $N$. In this paper, we introduce Local MixVR, a distributed framework that integrates local updates with variance-reduction techniques to mitigate local noise. We show that Local MixVR is the first distributed method to eliminate the dependence of communication complexity on $N$, achieving a complexity that scales only with the number of workers $M$. In common regimes where $M<O\left(N^{1/4}\right)$, Local MixVR outperforms the state-of-the-art Minibatch Accelerated SGD baseline, bridging a long-standing gap in distributed optimization and establishing a new paradigm for communication-efficient training.

translated_title: 本地MixVR：打破分布式学习中通信与样本量的依赖关系
translated_abstract: 通信开销是可扩展分布式学习中的一个关键瓶颈。虽然现有方法（如本地SGD、小批量SGD及其加速变体）旨在高效利用数据点，但它们的通信轮数复杂度仍然随总样本数N缩放。在本文中，我们提出了Local MixVR，这是一个将本地更新与方差缩减技术相结合的分布式框架，用于缓解本地噪声。我们证明Local MixVR是首个消除通信复杂度对N的依赖的分布式方法，其复杂度仅随工作节点数M缩放。在M < O(N^{1/4})的常见情况下，Local MixVR优于最先进的小批量加速SGD基线，填补了分布式优化领域长期存在的空白，并确立了通信高效训练的新范式。
tldr: Local MixVR是首个使通信复杂度摆脱对总样本量的依赖、仅取决于工作节点数的分布式学习框架，在常见场景下超越了现有最先进方法。
